description: Find Algerian communes by name, in French or Arabic. Handles accents, articles, transliteration variants (Djelfa/Jelfa, Beni/Bni), old official names and small typos. Returns the commune, its current wilaya (69-wilaya map, 2026) and a score where 0 is an exact match.

query.description: Commune name, e.g. 'bou saada' or 'Bains Romains'

wilaya.description: Only search in this wilaya, by code ('16') or name ('Alger')

name: search_communes
title: Search communes
